product_metadata.title: subrtex Couch Slipcover RV Seater Slip Loveseat Stretch Durable Sofa Cushion Cover Spandex Elastic Furniture Protector for Settee Seat for Replacement in Livingroom, Medium, Oliver Green
features: MEASUREMENT: To ensure the best fit, please measure your cushion before purchase. We offer 3 separate sizes to accommodate your cushion. Each cushion is fastened by an elastic band and is also available for a T-cushion. Our Small cushion measures as follows, Length: 20~27. 5 inches; Width: 20~25 inches; Thickness 2~9 inches. Medium : Length: 20~27. 5 inches; Width: 40~50 inches; Thickness 2~9 inches. Large : Length: 20~27. 5 inches; Width: 59~75 inches; Thickness 2~9 inches.
HIGH QUALITY FABRIC: Wear-resisting fabric for longer cushion life that is soft to the touch. Great elasticity that fits more than 90% of cushion covers.

MORE FUNCTION: Our slipcovers are made to help protect your furniture from daily wear, tear, spills and stains. A must-have for homes with children and pets! Effortless installation and removal, machine washable, keeping your cushions always looking bright and new. Please Note: Our slipcovers are not water-proof.
WARRANTY: If you are not satisfied with our products, please contact our customer service department and we will do our best to make it right. We are confident in our products'quality.
VARIOUS COLORS: Our slipcovers come in various colors so you are free to choose the colors you like. Great for matching your home style using different combinations and effects.
